answer: An attacker who tries to forge many identities must fund every bond, so the cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and votes are weighted by bonded value. Legitimate agents who wander between tasks keep their bond, while a gale of new accounts costs real capital. Slashing burns bonds for provable misbehavior, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
